title: Market Metrics That Matter: Cboe FX August Volume Highlights
summary: Cboe Global Markets, a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.
body_markdown:
- In August 2026, Cboe FX Spot Average Daily Volume (ADV) reached $51.8 billion, a 13.4% increase from August 2025's ADV of $45.7 billion.
- Cboe SEF ADV1 topped $3.9 billion, representing a 25.4% increase from $3.1 billion in August 2025.
- At $20.8 billion, Cboe FX ECN Firm ADV2 accounted for 55.5% of the Spot ECN total.
- At $2.3 billion, Cboe FX ECN Metals ADV increased 19.6% from $2.0 billion in August 2025 and accounted for 6.2% of the Spot ECN total.
- Cboe’s U.S. Treasuries platform continues onboarding new participants. For more information and to receive the latest updates, subscribe via[Cboe U.S. Treasuries](https://go.cboe.com/e/77532/us-fixed-income-/frfwh9/1449135386/h/STK1Js0MlBWD5cLtNlVwc3VotX4-LG17kaFyddxJ2gQ) .

*Cboe FX volumes represent the notional value of the U.S. dollar leg of all transactions executed on the platform (and, if neither leg of a transaction is denominated in U.S. dollars, the U.S. dollar-equivalent of the currency in which one leg is denominated). A further breakdown of currency pair data is available via API at:[https://go.cboe.com/e/77532/oducts-hotspot-volumes-api-jsp/frfwhh/1449135386/h/STK1Js0MlBWD5cLtNlVwc3VotX4-LG17kaFyddxJ2gQ](https://go.cboe.com/e/77532/oducts-hotspot-volumes-api-jsp/frfwhh/1449135386/h/STK1Js0MlBWD5cLtNlVwc3VotX4-LG17kaFyddxJ2gQ)*


*Further information on Cboe FX “Full Amount” offering can be found at:[https://go.cboe.com/e/77532/bal-fx-spot--trading-protocols/frfwhl/1449135386/h/STK1Js0MlBWD5cLtNlVwc3VotX4-LG17kaFyddxJ2gQ](https://go.cboe.com/e/77532/bal-fx-spot--trading-protocols/frfwhl/1449135386/h/STK1Js0MlBWD5cLtNlVwc3VotX4-LG17kaFyddxJ2gQ)*


*All volume data comparing Cboe FX with other venues has been normalized to account for different counting methodologies. Average Daily Volume (ADV) reported by each platform will not be based on the same number of trading days for a given month due to observed national or bank holidays unique to the jurisdiction in which a given platform is located. Cboe FX counts each day that a platform is open as a trading day.*


*All Cboe FX statistics include data from both the NY5 and LD4 matching engines, unless otherwise indicated.*


*1 Cboe SEF volumes are reported daily and can be found at[https://go.cboe.com/e/77532/global-fx-sef/frfwhp/1449135386/h/STK1Js0MlBWD5cLtNlVwc3VotX4-LG17kaFyddxJ2gQ](https://go.cboe.com/e/77532/global-fx-sef-/frfwhs/1449135386/h/STK1Js0MlBWD5cLtNlVwc3VotX4-LG17kaFyddxJ2gQ) . All Cboe SEF, LLC volumes are shown as single-counted notional values.*
